Class House

java.lang.Object
Building
House
public class House extends Building
Represents a house in the Candy Courier game. Stores the house's candy orders, required quantities, XP reward, and delivery status.

    • House

      public House(String name, int row, int column, Candy[] requiredCandies, int[] requiredQuantities, int xpReward)
      Constructs a House with the specified name, location, candy orders, required quantities, and XP reward.
      Parameters:
      name - the name of the house
      row - the row coordinate of the house
      column - the column coordinate of the house
      requiredCandies - the candies required by the house
      requiredQuantities - the required quantity of each candy
      xpReward - the XP earned upon completing the order
